description: This file defines constants, enums, classes, and utility functions related to LDPC (Low-Density Parity-Check) coding, including lifting sizes, codeblock size calculations, and graph representations, according to 3GPP TS38.212 specifications.

methods.name: compute_full_codeblock_size
methods.description: Calculates the full codeblock size after LDPC encoding based on base graph type and input codeblock size.

methods.name: compute_N_ref
methods.description: Calculates the N_ref parameter for rate matching according to TS38.212, considering transport block size and number of codeblocks.
